title: Next simulation phase
statement: Given an input-head movement $d\\in\\{-1,0,1\\}$ and Boolean values $lb,rb$, choose the next phase as follows: if $lb$ is true, choose ask when $d=1$ and otherwise choose work$(\\mathrm{none},\\mathrm{true})$; if $lb$ is false, choose zt when $d=-1$, choose iC when $d=1$ and $rb$ is false, and choose ask in all other cases.
